degree_definition: full preprocessed graph in-degree of target/root nodes

later_procedure.candidate_unit: complete batch from the frozen first-epoch training schedule
later_procedure.degree_strata: four dataset-specific equal-count rank partitions of candidate batches
later_procedure.selection_within_stratum: four complete batches selected by deterministic SHA-256 ranking
later_procedure.panels: after selection, sorted batch hashes at indices 0 and 2 form panel A; indices 1 and 3 form panel B
later_procedure.aggregation: pooled median over 32 checkpoint-by-batch dominance ratios
later_procedure.bootstrap: 10000 deterministic resamples preserving checkpoint-by-degree-stratum cell counts

not_retained: fixed numeric degree cutpoints, because the implementation uses rank partitions
